game_updates.title: 3.26.3.5 Patch Notes
game_updates.contents: Yesterday evening we received report of a remote code execution (RCE) exploit in a malicious server's workshop mod. As a precaution, we temporarily disabled all Internet server listings while we prepared and released this patch. At this time, we believe the impact was limited to a single small server.Our sincere thanks to celeb for reporting the exploit, to Jdance for creating a proof-of-concept test case (initially reported through the community Discord), and to Daniel Willett for running a scan of the past month of workshop uploads to check whether this exploit had been used anywhere else (fortunately, it was not)!FixedPrevent loading components with UnityEvents connected to static methods. game_updates.title: Official Discord Server Breach Update
game_updates.contents: We now have a full picture of the situation and would like to share the verified details with you.To get straight to the point: The game itself is 100% SAFE and virus-free. This incident was strictly limited to a single admin account's Discord being compromised.What Happened: While investigating and patching a malicious MOD map issue, a system engineer's PC was infected with malware. The hacker bypassed the engineer's Discord 2-Factor Authentication (2FA), took over server permissions, and banned all official staff members from the server.Game File Security: The infected PC was a spare testing machine, and it is physically impossible to access or edit game source files from it (which we have re-confirmed via logs). The affected PC has already been completely wiped and reformatted.A Warning...

game_updates.title: Regarding Game Safety (Clarification on Rumors & Misinformation)
game_updates.contents: Due to various rumors currently circulating within the community, we would like to summarize the verified facts.Q: Is there any virus embedded in the game? A: No. There are no viruses or malware embedded in the game itself. Claims made by the hacker who compromised our Discord—stating that "the latest update contains a RAT (Remote Access Trojan) and you must follow specific steps to fix it"—are 100% FALSE. We have never implemented anything of the sort, and this statement was made solely to cause panic and mislead players. Even if a hacker attempted to modify the game, Steam's developer infrastructure prevents anyone from publishing a game update simply by compromising a PC.Q: Is the game unsafe if I was in the Discord server?
